statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45363 affects jwt 2.10.3 with a fix available in 3.2.0. The fix requires a major version upgrade (2.x to 3.x) which carries significant compatibility risk for the logstash 8.19 line. The vulnerability allows forged tokens when an empty HMAC key is used with JWT.decode. Logstash's use of jwt is being evaluated to determine if the vulnerable code path is reachable in typical deployments and whether the major version upgrade can be safely applied.

CVE-2026-45363 affects jwt 2.10.3 with a fix available in 3.2.0. The fix requires a major version upgrade (2.x to 3.x) which carries significant compatibility risk for the logstash 8.19 line. The vulnerability allows forged tokens when an empty HMAC key is used with JWT.decode. Logstash's use of jwt is being evaluated to determine if the vulnerable code path is reachable in typical deployments and whether the major version upgrade can be safely applied.

Fix is in jwt 3.2.0. GitLab ships jwt 2.10.2 and the 3.x line is a major upstream change. The vulnerability affects HMAC verification with empty keys; GitLab's JWT implementation uses non-empty keys and does not expose the vulnerable code path. Awaiting upstream GitLab dependency update.
